name: vibecheck
description: Drop feedback pins on vibe-coded prototypes — internal design handoff tool
author: VibeCheck contributors

scripts.concurrent: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:js" "npm run dev:css" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:extension: npm run extension:build && npm run extension:local:version
scripts.extension: npm run extension:js && npm run extension:css && npm run extension:copy && npm run extension:local:version
scripts.extension:build: npm run extension:js && npm run extension:css && npm run extension:copy && npm run extension:sync-version
scripts.extension:release: npm run test:ci && npm run bump && npm run extension:build && npm run extension:zip
scripts.extension:copy: cp app/bundle.min.js extension/toolbar/ && cp app/vibecheck/release-plan.js extension/release-plan.js && cp -R app/tuts/ extension/tuts && rm -rf extension/fonts/figtree && mkdir -p extension/fonts && cp -R design-system/fonts/figtree extension/fonts/figtree
scripts.extension:zip: npm run extension:build && mkdir -p extension/build && rm -f extension/build/vibecheck.zip && cd extension && zip -r build/vibecheck.zip . -x "build/*"
scripts.extension:firefox: npm run dev:extension && cd extension && web-ext run
scripts.extension:firefox-build: npm run extension:build && cd extension && web-ext build
scripts.test:ci: npm run bundle && start-server-and-test test:server http://localhost:3000 test
